covers.name: FaithSeeker
covers.prompt: Use case: screenshot-based product presentation. Edit target: the attached real project screenshot. Create ONE polished landscape 16:10 software product mockup for a personal developer portfolio. Preserve the actual website identity, interface layout, branding, screenshots and recognizable existing text; do not invent another interface or add claims. Remove the source operating-system taskbar, scrollbar and original browser or Electron chrome. Present the actual interface in one very thin graphite browser frame with SMALL 6px corner radius, three tiny muted cyan controls, nearly straight front view with just a subtle premium perspective. Interface occupies 92% of canvas width and 86% of height. Tight, intentional composition with no blank sidebars, letterboxing or huge empty margins around the screenshot. Dark charcoal navy #10191e studio background with refined cyan #62dcf3 edge illumination and subtle photographic texture; soft contact lighting stays entirely inside the canvas. Clean boxy editorial product art, restrained depth, crisp screen, no excessive rounded corners. The whole mockup must be fully visible with consistent margins, no cut-off frame or shadow. No laptop keyboard, hands, extra objects, floating labels, new headline or watermark. Keep the project's original color scheme inside the screen. High quality bitmap cover; same coherent visual family as the other project covers. Project being presented: FaithSeeker.
